top_stories.title: Identity-Based AI Attack Threatens Security of Enterprise Data
top_stories.summary: A new attack technique called "workflow identity hijacking" has been identified, which exploits unauthenticated entry points to bypass standard security controls and compromise enterprise data. The attack targets identity-based weaknesses in automated workflows, allowing adversaries to hijack organizational data through basic requests that circumvent authentication mechanisms.

top_stories.title: Passkey-themed phishing attacks lead to Microsoft 365 data theft
top_stories.summary: Threat actors linked to ShinyHunters, Helix, and other extortion gangs are conducting phishing attacks themed around passkeys and single sign-on to compromise corporate Microsoft accounts. The attacks target Microsoft 365 services, exploiting user familiarity with passkey and SSO authentication flows as a social engineering vector.

top_stories.title: IDScan confirms breach after 153 million driver’s licenses leak on dark web
top_stories.summary: IDScan.net, an identity verification company, confirmed that hackers accessed customer data on its cloud platform after a dark web database containing over 153 million driver's license scans was linked to the firm. The Louisiana-based company posted a breach notice on September 4, acknowledging the incident that exposed ID verification data processed for car rental companies, retailers, and cannabis dispensaries.

top_stories.title: JumpCloud extends Agentic IAM with new controls for autonomous AI agents
top_stories.summary: JumpCloud has extended its Agentic IAM service with new controls that give IT teams direct management over autonomous AI agents operating within their organizations. The update places AI agents within the same identity and access management framework used for human users and traditional workloads.

top_stories.title: MFA's Weakest Link: Account Recovery Is the New Attack Path
top_stories.summary: Attackers are increasingly bypassing MFA by targeting account recovery and password reset processes rather than the authentication methods themselves. Specops highlights the need for stronger identity verification at the service desk to counter social engineering attacks on recovery workflows.

news.title: Florida confirms DMV database breached via stolen police account
news.summary: Florida's DMV database (DAVID) was breached by attackers using stolen credentials from a police department employee account. The incident highlights the risks of compromised privileged accounts used to access sensitive government databases.

news.title: Artifactory flaws chained in attacks deploying backdoor malware
news.summary: Threat actors are chaining critical and high-severity vulnerabilities in JFrog Artifactory to bypass authentication and gain administrative privileges on self-hosted servers. The attack chain culminates in the deployment of a Rust-based backdoor on compromised systems.

news.title: AI is changing what Salesforce security needs to govern
news.summary: WithSecure published a paper titled "Navigating Trust in the Modern Salesforce Ecosystem" examining how AI is expanding security and governance requirements in Salesforce environments. The paper argues that organizations must now govern information trust, cross-system trust relationships, and action outcomes in addition to traditional identities, permissions, and access controls.

news.title: authentik version/2026.8.2
news.summary: authentik released version 2026.8.2 of its open-source identity provider platform. The release supports SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, and RADIUS protocols for centralized authentication, authorization, and access management.

news.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
news.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act begins enforcing a 24-hour mandatory reporting requirement for serious product security incidents affecting European organizations. This regulation introduces new compliance obligations relevant to IAM and security teams responsible for managing access and responding to identity-related breaches.

news.title: CISA Flags Exploited Cisco, Citrix, Fortinet Flaws, Sets Sept. 12 Federal Patch Deadline
news.summary: CISA added three actively exploited vulnerabilities affecting Cisco, Citrix, and Fortinet to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, with a federal patch deadline of September 12, 2026. One of the flaws, CVE-2026-20079, carries a maximum CVSS score of 10.0 and involves an authentication vulnerability.

news.title: There's a New Black Market Just for Stolen ChatGPT and Claude Logins. It's Open 24/7.
news.summary: Okta has published a report revealing that stolen AI service account credentials (including Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor logins) are being traded on Telegram-based black markets with organized customer support and bulk pricing. The markets operate continuously and offer money-back guarantees, indicating a professionalized ecosystem for trading compromised AI platform tokens.

news.title: TATS
news.summary: A tool called TATS has been released that analyzes and tracks OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and Microsoft Entra ID tokens captured from Burp, mitmproxy, or Chrome DevTools. It provides features including token lifecycle visualization, risky scope detection, and token export for replay via an interactive dashboard.

news.title: Infostealer Logs Expose Replayable AI Tokens That Can Bypass MFA
news.summary: Cybercriminals are using infostealer malware logs to harvest replayable AI session tokens and API keys that can bypass MFA protections on AI platform accounts. Tools like Lumma Stealer and Vidar are being used to capture credentials, session tokens, and API keys from providers including Google and Anthropic, enabling account takeover without requiring re-authentication.

news.title: F5 BIG-IP APM Malware Injects a PHP Web Shell Into Memory, Evading Disk Scans
news.summary: Sophos identified malware targeting F5 BIG-IP Access Policy Manager (APM) appliances that injects a PHP web shell into memory to evade disk-based detection. The malware hooks into Apache's PHP script loading process, leaving disk files unmodified while maintaining persistent access through the in-memory web shell.

news.title: SAP Patches CVSS 10.0 Kernel Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
news.summary: SAP has patched a CVSS 10.0 severity vulnerability (CVE-2026-44756) in SAP Extended Passport (EPP) Processing that allows unauthenticated remote code execution via memory corruption. The flaw affects SAP's passport/identity processing component, which is directly relevant to authentication and identity infrastructure used in enterprise environments.

news.title: SailPoint, Inc. Q2 2027 Earnings Call Summary
news.summary: SailPoint held its Q2 2027 earnings call, with a summary produced by Moby. No specific financial figures, product announcements, or strategic details are provided in the description.

news.title: SailPoint Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
news.summary: SailPoint reported fiscal Q2 earnings with ARR rising 25% year over year to $1.231 billion and revenue increasing 17% to $309 million. SaaS ARR grew 36%, with overall performance exceeding expectations.

news.title: Dear SailPoint Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for September 9
news.summary: SailPoint is scheduled to report its fiscal Q2 earnings on September 9, with investor focus on profitability and revenue growth. The report centers on financial performance metrics tied to demand for SailPoint's identity security offerings.

news.title: Orchid Security gives enterprises a kill switch for rogue AI agents
news.summary: Orchid Security has added identity drift detection and application-level kill switches for AI agents to its Identity Control Plane product. The new controls allow security teams to revoke or restrict AI agent access and permissions at the application level.

news.title: Commvault Introduces Active Directory Pre Recover, Enabling Near-Real-Time Access to Trusted Identity Services During Cyberattacks
news.summary: Commvault launched Active Directory Pre Recover, a solution designed to restore Active Directory services in near-real-time during cyberattacks. The product targets scenarios where identity infrastructure is compromised, coupling recovery speed with recovery cleanliness to maintain access to critical systems.

news.title: Okta Earnings, AI Offerings Drive Shares Up 94% YTD
news.summary: Okta's shares have risen 94% year-to-date, driven by strong earnings and AI-related product offerings. The stock performance reflects increased demand for Okta's AI-enhanced identity and access management solutions.

news.title: firezone headless-client-1.5.12
news.summary: Firezone has released headless-client version 1.5.12 of its enterprise zero-trust access platform built on WireGuard. The release is a versioned update to Firezone's client software, which provides zero-trust network access capabilities for enterprise environments.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch batch addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. AI is being credited with accelerating vulnerability discovery, though security experts note organizations are struggling to keep up with testing and deploying the volume of fixes.

news.title: Old, Unpatched Flaws Give Attackers Access to Philippines Nuclear Agency
news.summary: Threat actors exploited unpatched vulnerabilities in ownCloud to breach the Philippines Nuclear Agency, stealing credential stores, personnel records, and reactor databases. The attack leveraged commodity vulnerabilities to gain initial access, resulting in the compromise of authentication credentials and sensitive identity-related data.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the breach.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved unauthorized access to customer accounts, stealing data including over 100 million AT&T customer call and text records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA conducted a postmortem after a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secret scanning and monitoring practices relevant to IAM and secrets management professionals.
